wo-jpfa-JR2076.d:
Supervise daily quality control inspections, testing, and monitoring activities in accordance with approved standards and procedures. Lead quality control inspectors or operators to ensure accurate and timely execution of quality checks. Identify, report, and follow up on quality deviations or non-conformities. Ensure completeness and accuracy of quality control records, reports, and documentation. Coordinate with production and relevant departments to maintain consistent product and process quality.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Melaksanakan operasi penetasan harian sesuai dengan SOP dan instruksi kerja. Melakukan tugas rutin termasuk penanganan telur, inkubasi, pemrosesan anak ayam, dan pembersihan. Menjaga standar kebersihan, biosekuriti, dan keselamatan setiap saat. Mengamati dan melaporkan kelainan dalam proses, kualitas anak ayam, atau peralatan. Mencatat data operasional harian sesuai kebutuhan. Mendukung aktivitas tim untuk memastikan kelancaran operasi penetasan..

wo-jpfa-JR5154.d:
Melaksanakan kegiatan harian di peternakan Parent Stock (PS) sesuai dengan instruksi kerja dan Prosedur Operasional Standar (SOP). Melakukan tugas rutin seperti pemberian pakan, pengumpulan telur, pembersihan, serta pemeliharaan dan perawatan kawanan ternak. Mengamati dan melaporkan kondisi ternak, tingkat kematian, serta kelainan atau masalah operasional kepada supervisor. Mematuhi persyaratan biosekuriti, kesejahteraan hewan, keselamatan kerja, dan kebersihan setiap saat. Menjaga kebersihan fasilitas, peralatan, dan area kerja. Mencatat data operasional harian secara akurat sesuai instruksi. Mendukung kegiatan tim untuk memastikan operasional peternakan berjalan lancar dan efisien.
